articles.title: Bitcoin, ether fall, equities rally with broader crypto market on track for best month in a year
articles.snippet: BTC fell as July drew to a close, even as stocks gained in Asia and U.S. index futures advanced. The CoinDesk 20 index is set to post its biggest gain since July 2025.

articles.title: Global banks test tokenized money for cross-border payments in $1 million BIS pilot
articles.snippet: Twenty-eight banks, including JPMorgan, Citi and UBS, moved real money across borders in a live test of blockchain-based settlement.

articles.title: Bitcoin price sinks to 2-week lows as US stocks fail to copy Asia rebound
articles.snippet: Bitcoin saw fresh downside pressure as US stocks tracked sideways into the end of the month, diverging from the relief bounce seen in Asia.

articles.title: US senators sent revised ethics rules to White House for CLARITY Act: Report
articles.snippet: The window to pass a comprehensive crypto market structure bill before the Senate breaks for a month-long recess is closing, with ethics a dividing issue for many lawmakers.

articles.title: Strategy posts $8.2B Q2 loss as Bitcoin slump drives unrealized losses
articles.snippet: The Bitcoin treasury company said it has built a $3.75 billion cash reserve to support preferred stock payouts following the launch of its BTC monetization program.
